name: stench
desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=mJbwhj3beOIB3Jgj]], any creature (other than a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}) that starts its turn in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=mJbwhj3beOIB3Jgj]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to the Stench of all [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} for 1 hour.
